description: Web file manager that lets you manage your data anywhere it is located: FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, Git, S3, Minio, Dropbox, or Google Drive.

promotion.reason: Withheld on 2026-09-10 although it qualified. The only importable definition is CapRover's, which pins an image tagged with a commit hash, b7b45f2, last built 2020-03-11. There is no release it corresponds to and six years of fixes it does not have.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Connects to storage you point it at — FTP, SFTP, S3, WebDAV and others — using credentials you type into it.
